title: Creative Commons Element Explorer
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Open Educational Resources
description: Switch the ShareAlike, NonCommercial, and NoDerivatives elements on and off, then predict what each resulting license allows.

learningObjectives: The learner will infer whether each of five actions is allowed under a given Creative Commons license by reasoning from its elements, with at least 7 of 8 predictions correct on the first attempt.
prerequisites: The four elements Attribution, ShareAlike, NonCommercial, and NoDerivatives, and the six licenses they form,

pedagogical.teachingStrategy: Predict, commit an answer, and read the reason
keyQuestions: Which element takes away this freedom?
Is the action a change, a sale, or a plain share?
commonMisconceptions: NoDerivatives forbids all changes, including private ones
NonCommercial only forbids selling the exact file
Any element can be combined with any other
assessmentOpportunities: A translation of a CC BY-ND work: allowed to post?
Can you sell printed copies of a CC BY-NC work?
Can you privately change a CC BY-NC-ND work?
Why can SA and ND not both be on?

controls.name: SA, NC, and ND switches
controls.description: turn each element on or off. Turning on SA while ND is on, or the reverse, shows an explanation instead of changing the license.

controls.name: Back to explore
controls.description: on the results screen, returns to the switches.
